Helpful answers

What teams ask before they begin.

What is OrgVia?

OrgVia is a multi-tenant HRMS platform that brings core people operations into a shared workspace for organizations and their teams.

Can smaller businesses use OrgVia?

OrgVia is intended for growing organizations that need clearer employee administration and HR workflows. A demonstration can help determine whether it fits your operating needs.

Which HR workflows does OrgVia cover?

The platform covers employee management, attendance, leave, payroll workflows, recruitment, onboarding and performance management where enabled for an organization.

Can we request a product demonstration?

Yes. Use the demo request page to share your requirements. Availability of the enquiry workflow depends on the sales destination being configured.
